# West Vancouver Mold Services

> Mold inspection, testing, detection and remediation information for residential, strata and commercial properties in West Vancouver, British Columbia.

Primary phone: (604) 800-3900
Primary service area: West Vancouver, BC, Canada
Canonical website: https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/

## Main pages

- [Mold Remediation West Vancouver](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/): Main service overview, remediation process, local coverage and frequently asked questions.
- [Mold Testing](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/mold-testing.php): Targeted air, surface and material sampling explained in building context.
- [Mold Detection](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/mold-detection.php): Investigation of hidden moisture, musty odours and concealed mold concerns.
- [Black Mold Inspection](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/black-mold-inspection.php): Assessment of dark growth without identifying mold by colour alone.
- [Attic Mold Inspection](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/attic-mold-inspection.php): Roof-space moisture, ventilation, condensation and leak investigation.
- [Crawl Space Mold Inspection](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/crawl-space-mold-inspection.php): Below-floor moisture, drainage, plumbing and framing assessment.
- [Condo Mold Inspection](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/condo-mold-inspection.php): Unit and strata-context moisture investigation.
- [Commercial Mold Inspection](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/commercial-mold-inspection.php): Documented assessment for commercial and managed properties.
- [Air Quality Testing](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/air-quality-testing.php): Mold-related indoor air sampling and interpretation.
- [About](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/about.php): Service approach and local property context.
- [Contact](https://moldremediationwestvancouver.ca/contact.php): Phone and enquiry form.

## Important context

- The website does not identify mold species by colour.
- Mold testing is presented as one part of a property and moisture investigation.
- Medical diagnosis and legal responsibility are outside the scope of the website.
- Service content is focused on West Vancouver neighbourhoods and property types.
